summary.headline: Zodiacal Chorography and Human Zodiac
summary.text: Zodiacal geography assigns regions of the inhabited world to planets and signs, including Babylonia, Persia, Roman dominion, India, Turkia, Asia Minor, Egypt, Khorasan, and Media. A table from an Armenian calendar codex maps peoples to human body parts and zodiac signs, alongside references to Apomasar, Frederick Conybeare, Paulus Alexandrinus, and Boll.
